_note: Thresholds and weights are UNCALIBRATED defaults. Run `python -m aicheck calibrate --real DIR --ai DIR` on your own labelled files before trusting any percentage.

onnx._note: Repo ships ONNX only (no pytorch weights), so transformers.pipeline cannot load it; run via onnxruntime. Output is 2 logits, index fake_index = fake. Preprocessing from the repo's preprocessor_config.json.

trufor._note: Uses TruFor's inference-only test_docker/src/trufor_test.py (CPU, -gpu -1). Weights: test_docker/weights/trufor.pth.tar (public zip linked from test_docker/README.md, md5 7bee48f3476c75616c3c5721ab256ff8). Script paths are relative to its own src/ dir, so it runs with that cwd. Writes <outdir>/<image filename>.npz with 'map' (localisation), 'conf', 'score' (image-level, 0..1).

seed._note: Per SEED's main.py: model takes raw 0-255 RGB (it normalises internally), 512x512 tiles padded with white, score = softmax(image_logits)[:,1] per tile; we take the max over tiles. max_side downsizes large pages (CPU speed) -> trade-off, raise it for fidelity. The backbone facebook/dinov3-vitl16 is gated on HF, so it is built from a hand-written ViT-L/16 config and the full weights come from the SEED checkpoint.
